name: manual_be32d3
claim: git merge-tree --write-tree takes exactly 2 positional branch args and auto-detects the merge-base; passing a 3rd positional arg silently produces a wrong/misleading result

decisions.notes: During cross-PR conflict simulation for #205/#206/#208, an explicit-base pairwise test was first written as 'git merge-tree --write-tree BASE branchA branchB' (3 positional args), which silently mishandled the 3rd arg and reported a false 'all pairs clean' result. The correct form keeps 2 positional branches and passes the base via the --merge-base=<tree-ish> flag: 'git merge-tree --write-tree --merge-base=BASE branchA branchB'. Re-running with the correct flag revealed the real conflicts.
